input.content: Thanks, Chen! I've located your account. Now, to find the tablet order — do you happen to have the order ID (it starts with '#W')? If not, no problem, I can look through your recent orders to find the one with the tablets. Also, just so you know: once we find it, I'll need to confirm the order was delivered, which tablet you'd like to return, and the payment method you'd like the refund to go to (the original payment method or an existing gift card).
